### Blasphemy against the Holy Spirit
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/blasphemy-against-holy-spirit
Passage: Mark 3:28-30
Points:
- Jesus’ miracles and exorcisms clearly manifested the power and authority of God over demonic forces.
- Blasphemy against the Holy Spirit involves a persistent, deliberate verbal attribution of God's work to Satan.
- Religious leaders committed this transgression in direct contradiction to their deep knowledge of Scripture.
- The unpardonable nature of this sin stems from a heart permanently hardened against divine grace and repentance.
- Anyone fearful or concerned about having committed this sin shows evidence of a repentant, responsive heart.
